rows.title_full: AN ACT TO AMEND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9189 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE OVERSEAS ABSENTEE VOTING ACT OF 2003
rows.title_short: Amending RA No. 9189, Otherwise Known as the Overseas Absentee Voting Act of 2003
rows.abstract: The bill proposes the following amendments, among others: a) for counting to be fully automated; b) for the scope of voting by mail to be widened; c) for the adoption of a continuing system of registration for Filipinos overseas; and d) for the adoption of a registration and voting mechanism adaptable to seafarers' situation.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PUNISHING THE CRIME OF KIDNAPPING-FOR-RANSOM WITH AMPUTATION OF UPPER AND LOWER EXTREMITIES THEREBY AMENDING ARTICLE 267 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: The perpetrators of kidnap-for-ransom should be dealt with punishment as severe as the crime they commit.  As a psychological deterrent, the measure proposes that the punishment of amputation of the upper and lower extremities be imposed.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 2007-02-07

rows.author: E058
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO BE KNOWN AS \"THE MARINE LIENS AND SHIP MORTGAGE ACT OF 2002
rows.title_short: Maritime Liens and Ship Mortgage Act of 2002
rows.abstract: \"Maritime Liens and Ship Mortgage Act of 2002\". The bill enumerates and defines the preference of maritime liens to enable ship financiers to assess favorably ship mortgages in the Philippines to ensure repayment of loans.  Moreover, this bill deals with maritime liens separately from ship mortgages and limits the number of claims secured by maritime liens to a minimum.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2007-02-07
